title: Small-Group Montreal Designers Shopping Tour with a Style Coach
includes: Fashion insider stories from your guide
Expert mini style consultation & tips from your style coach
Customized shopping tour of Montreal-based designers
Hotel pickup (unless option with Pick Up & Drop Off is selected) (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Montreal’s big names and up-and-coming designers as you shop local pieces based on your personal style. Learn about the city's unique fashion scene through news and stories from your guide while plunging into the creative DNA of Montreal's wearable art makers.

Prior to your tour, you'll receive a short questionnaire that your style coach will use to help customize your day. Based on your interests, follow along as your in-the-know guide leads you between sleek boutiques, independent studios, and secret spots where you will get inspired by the surrounding amazing fashions. Capitalize on your tour as you take advantage of exclusive special discounts just for your group.

Feel like a fashion icon as your style coach proceeds with your mini style consultation and shares tips and tricks as she pulls pieces for you while adding some fashion anecdotes to the mix. Receive your personal style report, a valuable source of knowledge on the art of dressing yourself.
